checklist.title: Valid Passport
checklist.description: Provide a passport valid for at least six months from the intended date of arrival in Sri Lanka.
checklist.guidance: Use a clear, readable copy. The passport details must match the application data.

checklist.title: Funds and Return Assurance
checklist.description: Show evidence of adequate funds and return or onward travel assurance for the intended short visit.
checklist.guidance: Recent bank statements and onward ticket or itinerary evidence are the baseline support set in this PoC.

checklist.title: Tourist Visit Purpose
checklist.description: Provide travel purpose details consistent with a short tourist visit to Sri Lanka.
checklist.guidance: Avoid mixing tourist travel with work, long-stay, or business-only activity in the same purpose statement.

checklist.title: Official Payment Channel
checklist.description: Use only the official ETA and immigration payment channels.
checklist.guidance: The product should make official payment and case references explicit to reduce scam exposure.

notes: ETA is not the same as final port-of-entry clearance.
Some nationalities or special cases may require sponsor-backed or manual handling.
Extension handling may require online steps, appointments, or head-office action.
